frontier.hypothesis: Diff a .cse (or .cse2) dump of the explicit-duplicate-cast variant against baseline's, to see whether cse1 even attempts the reg-72/reg-94 unification across the label-144 boundary and rejects it for a mode/cost reason, or never reaches it at all.
frontier.mechanism: cse.c's cse_end_of_basic_block extended-block tracking and its equivalence-table lookup (canon_reg) for a SImode zero_extend result vs a QImode store target.
frontier.next_probe: Re-apply the s6 explicit-duplicate-cast form, re-run tools/grinder/dump.ps1 _SsVmInit, and read the .cse/.cse2 dump's entries for the else-arm store insn and the compare's zero_extend insn side by side.

frontier.hypothesis: Hand-derive local-alloc.c's block_alloc/find_reg preference computation for reg 72 (crosses 2 calls, callee-saved candidate) vs the compare's transient pseudo, to determine whether target's choice of $a0 for the store is a preferencing artifact of reg 72's own allocation (once reg 72 is assigned $s1, is $a0 then preferred for ANY value that was live at the same point as the original a0-in-$a0, even a different pseudo)?
frontier.mechanism: local-alloc.c's qty/allocno preferencing tables (~line 1283 'two priorities for hard register preferences', ~line 1632-1691 quantity priority ordering) for a value whose life overlaps a parameter's original hard-reg home.
frontier.next_probe: Read tools/gcc-2.7.2/local-alloc.c around lines 1283 and 1632-1700 with this function's actual .greg dump register/quantity numbers in hand (not yet cross-referenced this session).

frontier.hypothesis: A directed PERM_* permuter macro (per .claude/rules/permuter-directives.md) sweeping specifically whether the else-arm store expression is spelled as bare `a0`, `(u8)a0`, or a cast-to-the-store's-own-type form, using the s5 hand-built workspace (tmp/grind/_SsVmInit/s5/perm_ws/, confirmed reusable) may find a spelling variant not yet tried by hand.
frontier.mechanism: same allocno-priority tiebreak; a directed sweep narrows the permuter's search to exactly this axis instead of the whole-function random space that already ran ~26k iterations with zero finds.
frontier.next_probe: Reuse tmp/grind/_SsVmInit/s5/perm_ws/, hand-annotate base.c's else-arm store line with PERM_GENERAL alternatives for the stored expression, launch a short directed campaign.
